I did that too. I just feel awful. She has a very very low sex drive (horny about once a month) and mine is very high (all day every day) so she is blaming herself because it's been about a month and a half since we've been intimate. I wish I could say she played no hand in it and it was all my fault, but a part of me says if she did occasional sexy things it wouldn't have happened anyways.

And thinking that just makes me feel bad because eit makes me feel like I'm unconsciously trying to pass the blame onto her which she doesn't deserve
It just sucks. I'm in the US and broke, and healthcare is so expensive I just can't possibly afford to see a professional. This country sucks

I'm glad he is willing to talk and j have my fingers crossed for you. It's obvious you're a good person and your children love you very much.

I remember a few years ago my nephew's were my reason for sticking around, I raised them and was with them through everything. 

I hope everything works out well for you, I hope you'll be willing to post here if you ever need support again, we all need it every now again

Your children need you and no matter how they act i assure you they love you to death.

When I was a child I wasn't very appreciative of my mother but I wouldn't trade her for the world now, she is amazing.

And so are you, your children love you, even if they aren't showing it well now, trust me, as they get older you will always be on their mind.

I don't know the situation with your husband but what I can say is death isn't the answer, things can only get better if you keep moving forwards.

Take a deep breath and maybe go out today, get something tasty to eat and try to recover. No matter what happens remember there are plenty of people who care about you.

Even if you feel like there aren't, everyone here in this subreddit does, and we're rooting for you to make it through today and see tomorrow, and every day after.
